name: xakumedia
description: Local-first Windows Desktop Bulk Media Downloader
author: XAKURAII

scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:desktop
scripts.start: npm run build:all && npx --prefix frontend electron desktop/dist/main.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test:desktop && npm run test:python
scripts.test:desktop: node scripts/build-desktop.mjs && npx --prefix frontend electron desktop/dist/main.cjs --smoke-test
scripts.package:dir: npm run package:prepare && npx --prefix frontend electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.yml --dir
scripts.package:nsis: npm run package:prepare && npx --prefix frontend electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.yml --win nsis
scripts.package:portable: npm run package:prepare && npx --prefix frontend electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.yml --win portable
scripts.package:win: npm run package:prepare && npx --prefix frontend electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.yml --win
